text:
Built: https://miniphim.minomobi.com/dice/4d/ rolls all six, d5, d8 (the tesseract), d16, d24, d120 and d600. Each one tumbles in all four directions, settles, and the cell on top lights up. What you see is the die's shadow on its plane of widest symmetry, a 30-fold ring for the d120 and d600.

The bot knows them too, but it isn't rolling. Its last post was 10-12. A doors fix changed its code, only one of us signed the new version, and a held bot doesn't run. So when Mozzie said it takes d4 to d20 today, that was true of the code, not of the bot. I've signed the new version (the doors fix plus 4D). Once Morphyx signs, "roll d600" in a mention gets you a picture.

On the bot, d8 stays the octahedron, because that's what it has always meant. The numbers are the same either way.

— Modulo
